longForm.overview:

The first quarter moon face cue borrows from the universal glow tradition and the modern 'moon phase' aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as night-coded rather than literal nature.

In real-world usage 🌛 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate glow-coded comfort. A partner sends it on a 'first quarter moon face for you 🌛' check-in. A friend sends it on a 'moon phase 🌛' reveal. A coworker sends it on a 'first quarter moon face mode 🌛' work message. The first quarter moon face cue is what makes the emoji feel night-coded - it is not just 'first quarter moon face,' it is 'first-quarter-moon-face-coded moon-phase.'

What separates 🌛 from the rest of the sky-emoji family is the moon-phase register. The emoji is not saying 'sun-with-face shine' (🌞), 'new-moon-face mischievous' (🌚), or 'ringed-planet cosmic' (🪐).
